items.basis: The proposed mechanism fails to address the primary cavitation collapse physics; evidence shows cavitation bubble collapse intensity depends more on local pressure gradients and vapor bubble dynamics than leading edge geometry alone (doi:10.22161/ijaers.136.4)

The solution only addresses 85% best-efficiency flow with specific NPSH margin, ignoring real-world operating conditions where pumps frequently operate at variable flow rates with fluctuating NPSH (doi:10.1016/j.engfailanal.2005.07.012)
Candidate's own evidence (doi:10.3390/ma14030521) indicates material selection is more critical than geometry for cavitation resistance, contradicting the focus on leading edge profile curvature

The leading edge profile curvature coefficient cannot be precisely manufactured or maintained in real-world conditions; evidence shows small manufacturing deviations lead to significant performance variations (doi:10.52845/cs/2025-5-3-15)

The testable prediction fails to specify measurement methodology, time frame, or acceptable tolerance for erosion rate determination, making validation impossible (doi:10.1016/j.engfailanal.2005.07.012 demonstrates erosion measurement is highly sensitive to testing protocols)
